about: Corrections applied on top of the dataset when the API builds its catalogue. Keep this short: one entry per additive, each with a source. Supported fields: bannedIn (list of places), euApproved (true or false), note (shown on the additive's page).

E171.note: The EU withdrew approval for titanium dioxide in food in 2022 (Commission Regulation (EU) 2022/63), after EFSA could not rule out genotoxicity. The dataset predates this.
